[Pre-Verse]
[D#5]A-
[C#5]lone against the world, twist a
reckless life
Straight into the heart of the
ripper.
Trick or treat my mind to a
rebel ride,
Heldorado move like a
monster.

[Verse 1]
[C#5]Creature of the wheel trigger
wicked way,
Tangle like a web beneath
me.
Ankle deep in hell through a-
nother way,
Crucify the sky above
me.

[Chorus]
[C#5]
New god kill machine
and man, Say-
lord of the en-
gines, yeah!
[D#5]

[Pre-Verse]
[C#5]Pocket full of dirt frozen
in my hands.
Hold on to the nameless
god, yeah.
Breathe into the deep and dying
light of day,
Overdose on bloody wings,
yeah.

[Verse 2]
[C#5]Splinter in the skin, turn your
eyes away,
Sick and swaggering beneath
me.
Revolution mind ye of
little faith,
Rusty and dull cut
me.

[Chorus]
[C#5]
New god kill machine
and man, Say-
lord of the en-
gines, yeah!

[Bridge]
[D#5]
[C#5]Creature of the wheel.
[D#5]No.
[C#5]Lord of the engines.
[D#5]No.
[C#5]Creature of the wheel.
[D#5]No.
[C#5]Lord of the engines.

[Chorus]
No.
New god kill machine
and man, Say-
lord of the en-
gines, yeah!

[Interlude]
[D#5]And oh bro-
[C#5]thers and sisters,
[D#5]I ask you to
[C#5]look at him.
[D#5]Does he have the marks?
[C#5]
[D#5]Do you see them?
[C#5]No.
[D#5]And oh bro-
[C#5]thers and sisters,
[D#5]I ask you to
[C#5]look at him.
[D#5]Does he have the marks?
[C#5]
[D#5]Do you see them?
[C#5]No.
[D#5]
[C#5]Demon paper clowns stitched a-
cross my back.
Easygoing dead black
eyes, yeah.
Microscopic giants on
a chicken run.
Everybody dies lau-
ghing.

[Verse 3]
Thrust into the drag on the
edge and wait.
Motivate the one inside
you.
Bastard kicker burn, blow the
ash away.
Heldorado gonna get
you.

[Outro]
[D#5]
[C#5]
